what_it_is: All Gold Weapons, All Skill Points

gamefaqs.section: PlayStation 2 PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)

format: PS3 Virtual Memory Card export (.PSV): '\0VSP' header, PS2 save type 2, 349640 bytes, folder BASCUS-97199RATCHET, 8 files, 349000 bytes of file data

title: Ratchet & Clank
save.times: as the file stores them (PS2 card times, JST)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/ps2-card.py 'BASCUS-9719952415443484554.PSV' -o OUT: reads the save with mymcplus 3.0.5 and writes OUT/Mcd001.ps2 (an 8 MiB card with ECC, formatted and filled by mymcplus) for lrps2/pcee2/pcsx2, and OUT/mc0/<folder>/ for Play!

converted.read_back: work/ps2/tools/mcfs.py lists every file with the size and SHA-1 put on the card; one-saves (1saves convert + inspect) reads the card and finds BASCUS-97199RATCHET
converted.timestamps: what the save does not date is 2000-01-01 00:00:00 (JST, as a card stores it); the card's own root entries too

pcee2.detail: Load Game lists 2 files: 00:04 1 challenge 132,967 bolts 04/30/08 and 21:15 266,806 04/30/08; Tobruk Crater, Novalis (no save: 'Please insert a Memory Card ... that contains Ratchet and Clank game data')

lrps2.detail: LRPS2 hangs at the end of the game's intro (no more frames, 100% CPU), with this save as with no card; stopped after 150 s with no frame of the load menu. The same hang is in ps2/NOTES.md for the played entries

play.detail: Play! hangs at the end of the game's intro (no more frames, 100% CPU), with this save as with no card; stopped after 200 s with no frame of the load menu. The same hang is in ps2/NOTES.md for the played entries

pcsx2.detail: Load Game lists 2 files: 00:04 1 challenge 132,967 bolts 04/30/08 and 21:15 266,806 04/30/08; Tobruk Crater, Novalis (no save: 'Please insert a Memory Card ... that contains Ratchet and Clank game data')

armsx2.detail: ARMSX2 renders only through Vulkan here and falls back to a null GS (no picture), so nothing shows what the game read (ps2/NOTES.md)
